description: Monthly subscription cost of every plan (or of the platforms you name) at a given number of units (long-term) or listings (short-term), cheapest first. Plans whose price is only a starting rate, or that add an unpublished fee or a share of each booking, are marked final_price=false and listed after the final prices.

billing.description: Billing cycle; best = cheaper of the two the vendor sells (default)

platforms.description: Optional platform ids from list_platforms; default all

section.description: long-term = property management software (size in units); short-term = Airbnb and vacation rental software (size in listings)

name: price_at_size
title: Monthly cost at a portfolio size
